case_title: Surinder Singh Deswal @ Col. S. S. Deswal & Ors. v. Virender Gandhi & Anr.
statutory_provisions: IPC s.138, s.148; Negotiable Instruments Act s.138, s.143-A and s.148
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for a period of two years and to pay jointly and severally an amount equal to the amount involved in the present case
neutral_facts: The accused, who were partners in a firm, issued multiple cheques in favor of the victim, a fellow partner, against retirement dues. The cheques were dishonored, leading to complaints under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. The trial court convicted the accused and imposed a sentence of two years' imprisonment and ordered them to pay compensation. The accused appealed, and the appellate court suspended the sentence pending the appeal, subject to depositing 25% of the compensation amount. The accused failed to comply with this condition, leading to the suspension of the sentence being vacated. The case was further appealed, and the Supreme Court upheld the appellate court's decision, dismissing the appeals and confirming the conviction.
